criteria.notes:
CITATION CORRECTED 2026-08-02, after review of PR #60. This record first cited `amendment.test.ts:71` — 'expect(result.envelope.canonicalHash).not.toBe(seed.authorizationEnvelopeId)' — as the 'distinct hash' bearer. That assertion is VACUOUS and has been dropped as a bearer: it compares a `sha256:<hex64>` against a testkit UUID (`buildChangeSet` draws `authorizationEnvelopeId` from the fixture id provider, packages/testkit/src/fixtures/change-set.ts:12), so the two values can never be equal and the expectation cannot fail whatever amendment does. It is also the wrong pair — an envelope hash against a ChangeSet's envelope ID field. The clause is genuinely evidenced, so this is a citation correction and not an UNMET: the bearers are now :251-280 (with :246 as its falsifying counterpart) and the :193-201 unit pair. Generalised by the reviewer into a wave-wide rule: a cross-type `.not.toBe` — hash vs UUID, id vs digest — is a silent vacuity pattern, because an inequality between values of different formats always passes. `amendment.test.ts:71` is left unchanged in the tree (fixing it is not this pass's job); strengthening it to compare against the PREVIOUS envelope's `canonicalHash` is a suggested follow-up.

Honest seam, unchanged: the criterion's two clauses are asserted separately rather than composed into one amend-then-replay test. 'Invalidates the prior token' is durable-approval-ledger.test.ts:77, the phase's own named amendment fixture, which supplies the amended digest directly instead of obtaining it from `amendEnvelope`. What links the two in production is asserted at contract-approve-handler.test.ts:242: the digest a token is checked against is re-derived from the ChangeSet's CURRENT envelope, so the repoint at amendment.test.ts:72-73 mechanically invalidates any token bound to the old hash.
